about.text: A historic Sicilian cheese, documented from the early 15th century, now made by factories and small dairies in Ragusa province. Cylindrical, 1 to 2 kg and ivory-white, it is made from cow's milk with animal rennet, pressed, then soaked for about an hour in hot whey before being sold after 15 to 20 days of ripening.
